name: Line Birds
storyline: Guide these cute birds through a world full of danger. Unlock new birds as you progress through the game. Each bird has its own special ability from getting invisible or using time warp to a powerful explosion ability.
summary: "Line Birds" is a line of casual style of the game, the game has five different shapes of lovely birds, and each have special abilities, as the game can be unlocked one by one. The game is very simple, click on the lower right corner of the bird up, loosen the screen birds, to avoid all kinds of obstacles along the way, see how far you can fly. Games will be a random bird food (watching like millet), after eating 3, click on the bottom left corner you can use the special ability of the bird.
